paper_title: Axion-Induced Patchy Screening of the Cosmic Microwave Background
notes: Forecast (projection) of sensitivity to axion-photon coupling from axion-induced patchy screening of the CMB, using Planck+unWISE and CMB-S4. The paper quotes reach 'as small as 3e-12 GeV^-1' for Planck over the mass range 2e-13 to 3e-12 eV; CMB-S4 could reach ~an order of magnitude lower (~3e-13 GeV^-1). Detailed mass-dependent curves are in Figs. 8-9 but not tabulated numerically, so only the quoted endpoint value is used as an approximate horizontal band. The axion makes up negligible DM fraction, so no local DM density assumption applies.
